newsitem.title: INDIA: India set for higher growth, policy to ease rates.
newsitem.headline: India set for higher growth, policy to ease rates.

text.p: India will post stronger economic growth in 1997/98 than the previous year and monetary policy will be generally supportive in bringing down interest rates, the governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Friday.

"...despite some deceleration in growth in 1996/97, the current economic scene reveals several positive trends, which would accelerate the growth momentum in 1997/98," Chakravarty Rangarajan told a meeting with business leaders.
